faq.q: How do I recreate an example with my own product?
faq.a: Upload a photo of your item and open the example you liked. Your file is built from that photo, in the same kind of scene.

faq.q: Can I upload my own product photo?
faq.a: Yes. The product in your file comes from the photo you upload. Use a photo that shows the whole item.

faq.q: Why start from an example instead of a photoshoot?
faq.a: An example shows a finished direction before you book a shoot. Upload one product photo, make a still in that direction, and check the product before you post it.

faq.q: Are these example images free to download?
faq.a: No. The pictures on this page are demonstrations, not files to repost. A file you generate uses credits. Plans start at $24.50 a month with 200 credits.

faq.q: Can I use a file I make in a paid ad?
faq.a: Yes. A file you generate can be used commercially and has no watermark. You download it and post it yourself.

faq.q: Will my result match the example exactly?
faq.a: No. Your file follows the direction you picked, using your photo. Check the shape and color before you post. A failed job returns its credits.

faq.q: Do the examples include captions, a price, or music?
faq.a: No. Add captions, a price, and licensed music after download. Nothing on this page is a finished ad with an offer in the picture.
No. Each card is a photo still. A product photo to video ad starts in a video tool. Clip lengths are 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds, in 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, or 3:4.
